messages:
Jules Park: Flagging a notable rise in churn-risk notes after last week's onboarding handoff change. Looks like CSM enablement didn't get the updated playbook mapping.
Kara Nguyen: Which mapping? I updated the handoff step to mark "enablement_requested" instead of "hand-off-complete" so trainers don't get duplicate tasks.
Jules Park: Rightbut healthscore mapping still awards +10 for hand-off-complete and 0 for enablement_requested, so accounts where only enablement_requested fired dropped 10 points.
Ben Ortiz: Oof. Two immediate options: revert the playbook, or backfill hand-off-complete where enablement_requested exists and trainer_assigned = true. Prefer backfill + scoring patch.
Kara Nguyen: Agree. Backfill safer. Ben, can you share SQL for candidates?
Ben Ortiz: SQL:
```
SELECT a.account_id
FROM onboarding_events a
LEFT JOIN trainer_assignments t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.event_type = 'enablement_requested'
  AND t.assigned_at IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM health_triggers ht
    WHERE ht.account_id = a.account_id
      AND ht.trigger_type = 'hand-off-complete'
  );
```
We will emit idempotent trigger id = sha256(account_id || '-handoff-backfill-202604').
CS-Data-Bot: Created export at s3://redwood-backfills/handoff-backfill/20260401.csv (size: 120 KB).
Kara Nguyen: Scoring patch: map enablement_requested -> +6 when trainer_assigned, else +0. A/B test on 15% of Growth cohort for 14 days.
Jules Park: Acceptance criteria: net on_track change <= 1.5% per cohort; all backfilled accounts have CSM note added with reason; playbook PR must include a short simulation of 90-day historical impact.
Ben Ortiz: I'll run staging backfill first. Throttle 20/s and include idempotency.
playbook-bot: Backfill task created: cs/playbooks/handoff-backfill (#559). Throttle=20/s, idempotency template enabled.
Ben Ortiz: Staging run summary: processed 420 accounts, emitted 388 hand-off-complete triggers, 32 skipped (already present). Health delta (staging): green +26, yellow -22, red -4.
Kara Nguyen: That looks reasonable. I'll open PR for scoring config and the CI sim.
Jules Park: I'll draft the CSM FAQ and prepare an enablement sync note so trainers know this was automated.
Ben Ortiz: Scheduling prod backfill for 2026-04-02T02:00Z. Will ping when done.
playbook-bot: Prod backfill completed: processed 4,215 accounts, emitted 3,920 triggers, 295 skipped. CSV uploaded to /ops/cs/backfills/hand-off-20260402.csv.
Jules Park: Post-prod health delta: green +310, yellow -280, red -30. Within acceptance. CSM broadcast sent with CSV and FAQ.
Kara Nguyen: Merged scoring patch: cs/score-enablement-weight (#477). CI sim passed. A/B rollout scheduled for 15% cohort starting 2026-04-05.
Ben Ortiz: Follow-ups: add a pre-deploy checklist item for any playbook change that touches handoff triggers, and a CI test comparing healthscore rollups.
Jules Park: Agreed. Closing thread unless we see regression in A/B.
